svg.text: UML Sequence Diagram: Group 3 – AI Interview Engine
Actor: Student | Real-time STT Live Streaming + TTS Question Delivery + LLM Adaptive Follow-up
[Slot Invalid or Not Scheduled or Time Expired]
[For each Main Question: while questions remain and within deadline]
[Student clicks Listen to Question for TTS]
[AI Follow-up Enabled and followUpsUsed < maxFollowUp and within deadline]
2. Connect and JoinExam: examId with JWT
5. LockExam: id, Query Candidate, Session, VivaSettings
409 Conflict: Slot not started or expired
Display waiting message or slot status error
6. Update Candidate Status InProgress, StartedAt now
Render exam screen and first question
7. Mark Candidate Status Completed, FinishedAt now
Display Exam Time Expired and disable inputs
Play audio question via Web Audio
502 Error: TTS unavailable, read text on screen
11. click Answer with Mic and speak
13. WSS Connect and Setup: PCM16, 16kHz, vi-VN
HubException: Live STT disconnected, fallback to text
Notify: Microphone disconnected, edit or type manually
16. Edit transcript or type manual answer in textarea
17. click Submit Answer or secondsPerQuestion expires
19. LockExam: id, Verify TurnId, Persist Answer
21. POST generateContent: Context, Expected, Rubric, Transcript
Bypass follow-up, proceed to next main question
22. Insert FollowUpQuestion: QuestionText, OrderNo, Reason, AskedAt
Display follow-up question, prompt for follow-up answer
Close turn for current main question
200 OK: TurnCompleted, advance to next question or complete
25. Update Candidate Status Completed, FinishedAt now
